Print the grade of a student from marks (A/B/C/D/Fail).

Supplied answer
marks = int(input("Enter marks out of 100: "))
if marks >= 90:
    grade = "A"
elif marks >= 75:
    grade = "B"
elif marks >= 60:
    grade = "C"
elif marks >= 40:
    grade = "D"
else:
    grade = "Fail"
print("Grade =", grade)
Note: Order the conditions from highest to lowest, otherwise every mark hits the first branch.
